He observed a bright object in motion above the horizon (600m), with a yellow-red color without a flash, not making the slightest noise, following the course of Joanes/Baía do Sol (w/SB), turning to the side of the Colorado coast, and was unable to follow the trace of the coast, increasing speed "subindo desapareceu no alto."

(re) , approximately at the time referred to above, observed a luminous object (appeared like a ball) which was located at a high altitude, "digging" a medial altitude, crossing the SE/MV, with a yellow-colored trail {Marcelo observed the object for some time over the tip of
Bacuri». Initially, it was thought to be completely gone.
DATE/TIME - 11/05/77, at 10:00 hours,

In his residence (Santo Antônio do Ubintuba), he observed the passage of a luminous object, clearly colored, descending-se to a height (40m) above the trees, coming from the direction of Belém (SV) towards Colares (NE), in the form of a cylindrical object, moving at a high speed. Not distinguishing details due to the brightness that radiated from the object, he affirms that it was not a flying saucer, since the altitude and distance did not permit a clear view.
